description: Download the receipt image or PDF attached to a Splitwise expense. The receipt URLs returned by sw_get_expense need the server's credentials — fetching them directly returns 401 — so use this tool instead. Set inline:true to get the bytes back in the result (images AND PDFs), or extract_text:true to get a PDF's text without the binary at all — both work when the caller can't see this server's filesystem. It also writes the file and returns the path, unless write:false or the filesystem is read-only.

extract_text.description: Also return the PDF's text layer as `text`. Ideal for looking up line items or totals without transferring the file. PDFs only; a scanned receipt has no text layer to extract.

id.description: Expense ID (the same id sw_get_expense takes)

inline.description: Return the receipt bytes in the result — an image block for images, an embedded resource for PDFs and everything else. Only for receipts under 4194304 bytes.

output_dir.description: Directory to write the receipt into. Defaults to $SPLITWISE_OUTPUT_DIR, else the current working directory. When SPLITWISE_OUTPUT_DIR is set, this must be inside it.

size.description: Which stored rendition to fetch. Defaults to 'original' (full quality, and the only one a PDF receipt has). Falls back to the other rendition when the requested one is absent.

write.description: Write the receipt to disk. Defaults to true. Pass false when the caller cannot reach this server's filesystem, or when the server runs read-only.

name: sw_get_receipt
